text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"One day near the end of winter break, I 
ran into Mr. C.B. out on a walk."
choice_data_list: Are you enjoying New Year's?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"I wonder. Probably no different from any 
usual day off. I'm not really interested 
in events and stuff."
choice_data_list: Are you enjoying New Year's?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
When people tell me to spend New Year's 
'properly,' I'm not really sure what that 
means.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Not being tied down by custom is very
like 
her. On the other hand, I also felt that 
marking milestones with events to refresh 
one's mindset is just as important.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This year is especially important with
the 
Classic season.
I want to help her get off 
to a fun start. And so—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I came here looking forward to seeing
what 
was in store, but—

Then I'll bring that New Year's 's...

text_block_list.text:
You prepared quite a lot of things,
didn't 
you?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... But like I said yesterday, I'm not 
really into events—
choice_data_list: I wanted you to enjoy New Year's t...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Wait, huh?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
A paddle and... a blue shuttlecock 
feather?
choice_data_list: You'll understand the secret of th...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Oh? That actually sounds kind of 
interesting. Then how about over there—
choice_data_list: You'll understand the secret behin...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: A kite? Looks pretty normal to me.
choice_data_list: I've got the materials ready so we...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Modifications? Nice, that sounds kinda 
exciting. Maybe I'll make it light up... 
or make it play sounds?
choice_data_list: I've prepared materials so you can...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
A match? Like, a beauty contest? Or 
smashing into each other? Wait—
choice_data_list: Let's have a battle with the kites...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I see... So that's something I get to 
decide for myself too...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
All right, you win,
that sounds fun. Let's 
hurry and go, I want to try everything!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: —Right... thereee!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (SMACK!!)

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh, that was so fun!! To think just 
making the shuttlecock sky-blue would
make 
it so hard to hit!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm exhausted from running all over 
the place. Flying kites and playing other 
games was so much fun!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
It really was so thrilling.
Has New Year's 
always been like this at your house?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Knowing she hated being boxed into 
standard molds, I gathered materials on 
the spot so she could brainstorm
something 
new.

No, this year is special.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I thought that if it was a New Year's 
without fixed rules—one that she could 
"create" herself—she might actually enjoy 
it...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
You're amazing. Are you some kind of play 
genius or something?
choice_data_list: You're exaggerating...!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: No, that's not true.
choice_data_list: You're exaggerating...!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"Because I assumed games I already knew 
would just be boring."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"Still, you have a real knack for freely 
transforming traditional things with your 
fresh ideas."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Aah. Somehow, it feels like such a waste 
to end it here.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I think I'd like to enjoy the lingering 
New Year's mood just a little while 
longer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With that,
I show her my trump card that I 
had prepared— a spinning top nearly as 
tall as a person.
choice_data_list: Then how about spinning a giant to...
Let's go fill our bellies!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, that's incredible! The rope is as 
thick as an arm!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"Now this is a challenge worth taking on. 
Alright,
Trainer! I'll leave supporting me 
to you!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Together, we bravely took on the giant 
spinning top. In the end,
we couldn't spin 
it well, but it was a fun New Year's 
pastime nonetheless.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thinking playing around would work up an 
appetite, a variety of unique ozoni 
arrangements had been prepared.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Amazing,
you've thought of everything! Can 
I come up with a new flavor too?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, next time let's try apricot and 
cinnamon! I bet chocolate sauce would go 
great with it too!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Following Mr. C.B.'s whims, we thoroughly 
enjoyed the unique, unconventional ozoni.
